implemented: Narrow adapters read durable employer state and LinkedIn state/parser output without reading either producer CSV export.
Every observation carries canonical employer mapping, source, source job ID, source URL, apply URL/type, scope, cycle/scan IDs, observed timestamp, content hash, and schema version.

LinkedIn ownership, Easy Apply, applicant, source-company, run, scan, and transport evidence are retained; employer ATS/discovery/extraction evidence is retained; absent fields are explicit unknown values.
Source observations remain distinct and raw producer records are retained at the adapter boundary.

SQLite acquisition delivery distinguishes intermediate batches from explicit final complete snapshots and rejects unsafe closure inputs.
The public adapter export surface names the actual SOURCE_EMPLOYER and SOURCE_LINKEDIN constants.
